response.text: {"question":"As of 03 August 2024, what must a commercial bank or NBFC consider when evaluating the adoption of cloud computing services according to RBI guidance?","answer":"They must assess their business strategy, goals, current IT application footprint, and associated costs, and base the decision on a business technology risk assessment that determines which workloads—ranging from non‑critical to critical applications—can be moved to the cloud.","answerable":true}
